# Get-AzureSubscriptionReport

<!-- Generated by tools/Build-Catalog.ps1. Edit the script header, not this file. -->

Produces a per-subscription overview of resource counts, resource groups and privileged role assignments.

| | |
|---|---|
| Location | `scripts/windows/azure/Get-AzureSubscriptionReport.ps1` |
| Platform | Windows (PowerShell 5.1+ with Az.Accounts and Az.Resources modules) |
| Permissions | Azure RBAC Reader on each subscription to be included |
| Safety | Read-only |

## When to use

First look at an unfamiliar tenant, to size an engagement, or to find empty or disabled subscriptions.

## Description

Loops over every subscription the signed-in account can see and records its state, total resources, counts of
VMs, storage accounts, SQL, network, web app and Key Vault resources, resource group and tagged resource group
counts, and the number of Owner and Contributor assignments at subscription scope. A subscription that cannot be
read is listed with State "Error".

Output is an HTML report (primary) with totals and one row per subscription, plus an optional CSV with the full
column set. The script makes no changes to Azure.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-SubscriptionIds` | String[] | No | Currently not applied: the script audits every accessible subscription regardless of this value. |
| `-OutputPath` | String | No | Folder for the report. Falls back to $env:TOOLBOX_REPORT_DIR, then prompts. |
| `-CustomerName` | String | No | Optional. Adds a &lt;OutputPath&gt;\&lt;CustomerName&gt; subfolder. |
| `-ExportCsv` | SwitchParameter | No | Also write the full result set to a CSV next to the HTML report. |
| `-IncludeSpending` | SwitchParameter | No | Reserved. Accepted for compatibility but currently has no effect (no cost data is collected). |
| `-SkipAzConnect` | SwitchParameter | No | Use the existing Az session instead of calling Connect-AzAccount. |

## Examples

```powershell
.\Get-AzureSubscriptionReport.ps1 -OutputPath D:\Reports
```

```powershell
.\Get-AzureSubscriptionReport.ps1 -ExportCsv -SkipAzConnect -CustomerName Contoso -OutputPath D:\Reports
```
